company.name: Talkable
company.shortDescription: Talkable is a technology platform that enables marketers to run customizable Refer A Friend Programs.
company.description:
Talkable (formerly Curebit) helps online stores increase revenue through referrals by turning existing customers into marketers.

When customers check out from a Talkable-enabled store, they are presented personalized deals that they can gift to their friends by posting to Facebook or forwarding a link. The deals give both the the original customer and their referred friends a rebate on their purchase at this store.

aiResearchSummary.text: Talkable is researching a system and method specifically tailored for the inclusion and sharing of short form video within referral marketing. According to the abstract, the system displays a share screen to an advocate who can record or attach a video as part of a referral campaign. This work focuses on enhancing refer a friend program workflows with embedded short form video capture, attachment, and sharing capabilities, advancing referral marketing and advocate driven video content generation.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Venture round round raised $3,000,000, or 71.43% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,104,760 to $20,151,726, a 6.49x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 30 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 42 (-12).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
